prompt: Design a complete, multi-threaded Transport Management System in C# with three isolated modules: (1) Fleet Telemetry Tracker handling GPS streaming and speed anomaly detection, (2) Route Optimization Engine utilizing Dijkstra's algorithm with live traffic weights, and (3) Automated Billing & Invoicing Subsystem calculating dynamic tolls. Provide fully functional, decoupled class architectures and show how data flows between Module 1 and Module 2.

criterion_scores.name: Module 1 Telemetry Score
criterion_scores.justification: Uses thread‑safe ConcurrentDictionary and Subjects to safely ingest and parse telemetry, handling anomalies without blocking.

criterion_scores.name: Module 2 Routing Score
criterion_scores.justification: Implements a thread‑safe Dijkstra algorithm with live traffic weighting and proper graph lock management.

criterion_scores.name: Module 3 Billing Score
criterion_scores.justification: Calculates tolls and penalties correctly but lacks robust handling of missing toll rates or invoice edge cases.

criterion_scores.name: System Integration Score
criterion_scores.justification: Data flows through reactive streams linking the modules but the demo wiring is simplistic and lacks full error handling.
